answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 39691 Country: Bangladesh Title: While in the middle of wudhu, if any of the causes that break the wudhu takes place Question: While in the middle of wudhu, if any of the causes that break the wudhu takes place, then should I start wudhu from beginning again? Answer ID: 39691 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1007/601/L=1433) Yes, in case you encounter anything which breaks the wudhu while making wudhu you would have to repeat your wudhu. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
